name: Takumi Takeo
source:
A member of Glittering Crux's second section Vanishing Age squad. His Cybody is named Zayinth and possesses the Star Sword "Grenat" along with projectile weapons known as Zayinth Sphere. His first phase ability is the manipulation of trajectories of objects, which he uses to cheat during a class baseball game. He was attracted to [url=/c83002]You Marino[/url] even before he learned she was Manticore. He is a classmate of [url=/c80915]Mizuno[/url] and Marino.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Star_Driver_characters##Glittering_Crux_Brigade]Wikipedia[/url].]
